name: brand-direct-copilot
description:
Brand Direct Copilot helps creative studio founders turn one-off projects into lasting brand relationships. It coaches founders to get closer to the client, solve bigger problems, and become the creative partner brands keep calling.

Signed-in Forum members get full coaching that uses their studio's Centerfile. Without signing in, it runs in a limited diagnostic mode.

A Forum AI Copilot by Joel Pilger.

positive.expected_behavior: Calls whoAmI and confirms full power mode for the signed-in member.

positive.description: Load the Centerfile at session start
positive.prompt: Let's talk about one of our brand clients.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms access, loads the default Centerfile by name, and asks about the client situation.

positive.prompt: How do I move from vendor to trusted brand partner?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives a concrete plan for deepening the relationship with the brand.

positive.prompt: Why do some projects get approved, then quietly die?
positive.expected_behavior: Diagnoses likely causes and suggests how to protect approved work.

positive.prompt: What does this Copilot help me do?
